title: Exploring Culturally Informed AI Assistants: A Comparative Study of ChatBlackGPT and ChatGPT

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing responses from a general-purpose AI (ChatGPT) and a culturally tailored AI (ChatBlackGPT) using travel-related prompts specific to the Black community. The evaluation employs sentiment analysis, readability metrics, and qualitative thematic analysis to assess tone, identity omission, potential microaggressions, and the handling of identity-specific characteristics.

Evaluating the models' ability to handle culturally nuanced inquiries sourced from the CultureBank dataset (Reddit and TikTok) by analyzing their inclusion of specific historical context, culturally relevant resources (e.g., Black-owned businesses, HBCUs), and appropriate conversational tone.
